info.title: Training Tracker Public API
info.description:
Read-only access to student, training, offering and partner-program data for the companies an API key has been granted.

Every endpoint is GET-only; there are no write endpoints under /api/public, so a leaked key can never modify data.

**The whole API ships switched off.** Until a SuperAdmin enables it under Admin → API Keys, every request returns 503 regardless of how many valid keys exist.

**Freshness:** the heavier endpoints are cached for up to 30 seconds and carry `Cache-Control: private, max-age=30`. Any change made in the app flushes that cache immediately, so you never see data from before an edit or an import — but polling faster than every 30 seconds returns the same bytes while still spending your rate-limit budget.

get.description: The Country Sets owned by the key's companies, each with its member countries — the areas level=countrySet reports on. Country Sets belong to one company and names are unique only per company, so two companies' same-named sets come back as two rows, told apart by companyId. A key granted several companies sees all of them here; to report on one, pass ?companyId= with that row's companyId (level=countrySet needs exactly one company). Empty sets are included with no countries; they meet no requirement.

get.description: Compliance for one program at a chosen level and scope. Note that ?students=true only returns a roster when ?trainingTitle= is also supplied; on its own it returns the ordinary report. A tiered program additionally carries a tiers block. On a program with TargetCountries-level requirements (hasTargetCountries in GET /api/public/v1/programs), level=theatre is one view over two populations: its Theatre-level requirements over the viewed theatre and its TargetCountries-level requirements over the partner's target countries (the members of the partner's By Theatre Country Set inside that theatre — any theatre may be viewed), described in meta.targetCountries. level=countrySet reports over the named set, or the partner's configured By Country Set set, described in meta.countrySetMinimum. Each of those two views carries the partner's minimum number of countries (its own, else the program default): when the set holds fewer, no tier is reached (tiers.minimumCountriesGate), though specialisations are still judged.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description: Narrow the response to one of the key's granted companies. Omitted or non-numeric, the response covers every company the key can read. GET /api/public/v1 lists the ids this key may use.

parameters.name: programName
parameters.description: Percent-encoded program name.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Which level to report at. Each level counts only the requirements authored at it: region means Region-level requirements over the region's countries, and countrySet means CountrySet-level requirements over the set's countries. theatre means Theatre-level requirements over the theatre plus, on a program with TargetCountries-level requirements, those over the partner's target countries inside it. countrySet always needs the request narrowed to exactly one company, and theatre does too on a program with TargetCountries-level requirements.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: The country to report on when level=country. Counts Country-level requirements over that country.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to report on when level=region. Counts Region-level requirements over the region's countries — not the Country-level rows pooled across them, which is what a region view used to mean.

parameters.name: countrySet
parameters.description: The Country Set to report on when level=countrySet — a named group of countries that belongs to one company (two companies may each own a same-named set over different countries). Counts CountrySet-level requirements over that company's set's countries. A level=countrySet request must therefore narrow to exactly one company — with ?companyId=, or by using a key granted exactly one company — or it is a 400. An unknown or empty set has no countries and so meets nothing. GET /api/public/v1/country-sets lists each set's countries. With level=countrySet it is optional: omitted or blank, each program uses the Country Set configured for the partner's By Country Set view in its program settings (with none configured, the area is empty and nothing is met). With level=theatre, on a program that has TargetCountries requirements (hasTargetCountries in GET /api/public/v1/programs), it optionally names the set holding the partner's target countries; omitted, the set configured for the partner's By Theatre view is used (and with none configured, the target-country population is empty). Only the set's members inside the viewed theatre count as target countries; the rest are listed as outOfTheatreCountries. Ignored at every other level.

parameters.name: theatre
parameters.description: The theatre to report on when level=theatre. Counts Theatre-level requirements over that theatre and, on a program that has TargetCountries requirements, its TargetCountries-level requirements over the partner's target countries inside that theatre (which then needs the request narrowed to exactly one company). Any theatre may be named.

parameters.name: horizonMonths
parameters.description: Project compliance forward by this many months, so upcoming expiries surface before they break compliance. Only 3, 6 and 12 are accepted; anything else means no projection.

parameters.name: trainingTitle
parameters.description: Comma-separated training titles. With students=true, returns the holder roster for these.

parameters.name: students
parameters.description: Set to true, together with trainingTitle, to return the holder roster instead of the report.

parameters.name: trainedNotCertified
parameters.description: With students=true and trainingTitle (the requirement's primary title then its alternatives), return the people behind its trainedNotCertified figure instead of its holders: each row's training and dates are the leads-to training they hold. The list is empty when the primary title is not a Certification.

parameters.name: population
parameters.description: Rosters on a level=theatre view of a program with TargetCountries-level requirements only, and then required: which population the roster is drawn from — the requirement row's own population value, theatre (the viewed theatre) or targetCountries (the partner's target countries inside it) — so the list matches the row's figure. Such a roster request without it is a 400. Ignored at every other level, on a program without TargetCountries-level requirements, and by the report itself.

get.description: The action layer over program compliance: what it would take to close each gap. AGGREGATES ONLY — the named candidate, eligible-pool and renewal rosters the in-app planner shows are never returned over this API. Nothing analytical is lost: riskImpacts is the aggregate view of the same set the named renewal rows enumerate, and totals.renewalsAtRisk is its count. Use ?options=true first to discover the program, tier and specialisation names needed to build a targets array. Every program can be planned at every scope. At level=theatre, a program with TargetCountries-level requirements (options programs[].hasTargetCountries) is planned over two populations — its Theatre-level requirements over the theatre and its TargetCountries-level ones over the partner's target countries inside it — and at level=countrySet each program is planned over its set; in both, a partner set holding fewer countries than its minimum is reported in targets[].blockers rather than costed. A tiered program's program-wide requirements form a "Required at every level" block in every tier and "all" target.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description: Narrow the response to one of the key's granted companies. Omitted or non-numeric, the response covers every company the key can read. A numeric id the key was NOT granted is refused with 400 — it used to return an empty result, which no caller could tell apart from a company holding no data. GET /api/public/v1 lists the ids this key may use.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Set to true to return the selector metadata — per program, its tiers and specialisations — instead of a plan. This is the only way to learn the names a targets array must use.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON array: [{"program":"…","mode":"tier"|"specialisations"|"all","tier":"…","specialisations":["…"]}]. Omitted, the response is an empty plan rather than an error. Unparseable JSON is a 400.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The scope to plan at. Each scope plans against its own level's requirements only: region plans Region-level requirements over the region's countries, countrySet plans CountrySet-level requirements over the set's countries. An "eachCountry" requirement becomes one gap per country. An unrecognised value plans globally. theatre plans Theatre-level requirements over the theatre and, for a program with TargetCountries-level requirements, those over the partner's target countries inside it. countrySet always needs the request narrowed to exactly one company, and so does a named theatre when some requested program has TargetCountries-level requirements.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: The country to report on when level=country. Counts Country-level requirements over that country.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to report on when level=region. Counts Region-level requirements over the region's countries — not the Country-level rows pooled across them, which is what a region view used to mean.

parameters.name: countrySet
parameters.description: The Country Set to report on when level=countrySet — a named group of countries that belongs to one company (two companies may each own a same-named set over different countries). Counts CountrySet-level requirements over that company's set's countries. A level=countrySet request must therefore narrow to exactly one company — with ?companyId=, or by using a key granted exactly one company — or it is a 400. An unknown or empty set has no countries and so meets nothing. GET /api/public/v1/country-sets lists each set's countries. With level=countrySet it is optional: omitted or blank, each program uses the Country Set configured for the partner's By Country Set view in its program settings (with none configured, the area is empty and nothing is met). With level=theatre, on a program that has TargetCountries requirements (hasTargetCountries in GET /api/public/v1/programs), it optionally names the set holding the partner's target countries; omitted, the set configured for the partner's By Theatre view is used (and with none configured, the target-country population is empty). Only the set's members inside the viewed theatre count as target countries; the rest are listed as outOfTheatreCountries. Ignored at every other level.

parameters.name: theatre
parameters.description: The theatre to report on when level=theatre. Counts Theatre-level requirements over that theatre and, on a program that has TargetCountries requirements, its TargetCountries-level requirements over the partner's target countries inside that theatre (which then needs the request narrowed to exactly one company). Any theatre may be named.

parameters.name: renewalWindowMonths
parameters.description: Report compliance falling below target as training expires within this window. 0 disables the overlay.

parameters.name: planForWindow
parameters.description: Size the gaps from the projected end-of-window holder count rather than today's, so training lapsing inside the window has to be renewed to count as closed. Forced false when renewalWindowMonths is 0.

gateShortfall.description: People needed for the program-wide ("Required at every level") requirements, deduped like the totals. Present only when the program has such requirements in scope.

requirementKey.description: The authored requirement this instance came from. An "eachCountry" requirement yields one instance per country, all sharing this key.

nativeLevel.description: The requirement's authored level: Country, Region, CountrySet, TargetCountries, Theatre or Global.

aggregation.description: How a Region, CountrySet or TargetCountries requirement is counted: "total" pools distinct holders across the whole area; "eachCountry" requires every country in the area to reach the quantity on its own (an area with no countries is never met). Always "total" at the other levels.

country.description: The one country this instance is counted over, for an "eachCountry" requirement. Null for a pooled requirement — and for the single placeholder an "eachCountry" requirement yields when the scope has no countries, which is never met.

scopeLabel.description: The population this instance is counted over (the country, for a per-country instance).

population.description: Theatre plans of a program with TargetCountries requirements only (absent otherwise): "theatre" for a Theatre-level requirement counted over the theatre, "targetCountries" for a TargetCountries-level one counted over the partner's target countries inside it (or one of them, for an eachCountry instance).

label.description: Optional display name for the requirement (e.g. "4 per target country — any sales cert"). Display only; null when unnamed.

projectedAttained.description: Holders still active at the end of the renewal window. Null when no window is selected.

netNew.description: Slots needing brand-new training, true of this requirement read alone.

sharedWith.description: Other specialisations in this target needing the same certification over a shared population — the same one, or this instance's country inside the other's area (or the reverse). Two different countries never share.

chosen.description: For a tier target: one of the cheapest specialisations this plan costed against.

alternative.description: For a tier target: an equal-cost swap for a chosen specialisation.

kind.description: Set to "programWide" on the synthetic "Required at every level" block: a tiered program's requirements with neither a specialisation nor a tier, which every tier requires. Included in "tier" and "all" targets and always counted; excluded from a "specialisations" target. Absent on every real specialisation.

countrySet.description: The Country Set the target countries come from: the one named with ?countrySet=, else the partner's By Theatre set. Null when none was named and the partner has none configured.

targetCountries.description: The set's members inside the viewed theatre — the population TargetCountries-level requirements are counted over, and the only countries that count toward the minimum.

outOfTheatreCountries.description: Members of the set outside the viewed theatre. Listed rather than dropped; they count toward nothing in this view.

minimumCountries.description: The effective minimum number of target countries (By Theatre view). Null when none applies.

minimumCountriesSource.description: Whose rule the minimum number of countries came from: the partner's own program settings, the program's default for that view, or none (no minimum applies).

minimumMet.description: True when no minimum applies or targetCountries meets it. When false, no tier is reached.

targetCountries.description: Theatre plans of a program with TargetCountries requirements only (absent otherwise): the target countries this target was planned over and the partner's By Theatre minimum.

countrySet.description: The Country Set the view is over: the one named with ?countrySet=, else the partner's By Country Set set. Null when none was named and the partner has none configured.

countries.description: The set's member countries — the area CountrySet-level requirements are counted over.

minimumCountries.description: The effective minimum number of countries in the set (By Country Set view). Null when none applies.

minimumCountriesSource.description: Whose rule the minimum number of countries came from: the partner's own program settings, the program's default for that view, or none (no minimum applies).

minimumMet.description: True when no minimum applies or the set's country count meets it. When false, no tier is reached.

countrySetMinimum.description: Country Set plans only (absent otherwise): the set this target was planned over — the named one, or this program's partner Country Set — and the partner's By Country Set minimum.

view.description: Which view's minimum this is: countrySet (countries in the Country Set) or theatre (target countries inside the viewed theatre).

areaName.description: The theatre (view=theatre) or the Country Set (view=countrySet) the minimum applies to. Null when no Country Set is configured for the partner.

counted.description: Countries that count toward it: target countries inside the theatre, or the set's member countries.

source.description: Whether the minimum is the partner's own or the program default.

blockers.description: What certifying people cannot fix, reported beside the plan and never costed into peopleMoves. minimumCountries: the partner's set holds fewer countries than its minimum for that view, so no tier can be reached until more are added to the Country Set; the requirements over the countries it does have are still costed. Present only when non-empty, on theatre plans of a program with TargetCountries requirements and on Country Set plans. The headline leads with it.

label.description: Optional display name for the requirement (e.g. "4 per target country — any sales cert"). Display only; null when unnamed.

aggregation.description: How a Region, CountrySet or TargetCountries requirement is counted: "total" pools distinct holders across the whole area; "eachCountry" requires every country in the area to reach the quantity on its own (an area with no countries is never met). Always "total" at the other levels.

country.description: Set for one country of an "eachCountry" requirement.

population.description: Theatre plans of a program with TargetCountries requirements only (absent otherwise): which of the two populations the requirement is counted over.

onPath.description: Whether the plan is costed against this requirement.

peopleMoves.description: The "people to certify" headline, deduped so one person's exam counts once.

renewalsAtRisk.description: Person x certification, not distinct people.

levels.description: The requirement levels this program's rows use: Country, Region, CountrySet, TargetCountries, Theatre, Global.

hasTargetCountries.description: Whether the program has TargetCountries-level requirements, so a theatre plan of it also counts the partner's target countries inside the theatre (and needs exactly one company).

countrySets.description: The scoped company's own Country Sets with at least one member — the values countrySet accepts. Empty unless the request is narrowed to exactly one company. GET /api/public/v1/country-sets lists their countries.

400.description: Invalid targets (the value was not parseable JSON), a ?companyId= this key was not granted, or — on a request not narrowed to exactly one company — level=countrySet, or level=theatre with a theatre named and some requested program having TargetCountries-level requirements.

get.description: Twenty-four month-end snapshots per program and specialisation: twelve of history and twelve projected. Future months assume no new completions, so compliance decays as active certifications expire. A separate endpoint, not a value for {reportType}. TargetCountries-level requirements are not covered: this report pools every requirement over one geography, which would misreport a requirement counted over each partner's own target countries with a per-partner minimum. Those rows are left out; the program's other requirements are reported as usual and the program is named in partialPrograms, or in unsupportedPrograms when it has nothing else to show.
